title: Extension by zero
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $U$ and $\overline X$ be schemes,
and let $j:U\hookrightarrow\overline X$ be an open immersion
[def-weil-open-immersion] of schemes, and use the small pro-etale
sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the constant coefficient
sheaf $A$, i.e. the constant sheaves of rings $A_U$, $A_{\overline X}$
[def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and the categories $\Sh(-,A)$ of sheaves of
modules over them [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. This includes the rings $A_{E,n}$ of the finite-torsion
coefficient construction [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility].
By [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization], $U_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is the
localization $\overline X_{\mathrm{proet}}/U$, $A_U$ is the restriction
$A_{\overline X}|_U$, and an object $V\to\overline X$ of $\overline X_{\mathrm{proet}}$
has at most one $\overline X$-morphism $V\to U$, which exists exactly when
$V\to\overline X$ factors through $U$ and is then an object of $U_{\mathrm{proet}}$. For a module sheaf $M$ on $U_{\mathrm{proet}}$, define extension by zero by
sheafifying [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] the module presheaf

$$
 P_M(V)=
 \begin{cases}
 M(V\to U),&\text{if }V\to\overline X\text{ factors through }U,\\
 0,&\text{otherwise},
 \end{cases}
$$

the extension-by-zero presheaf [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] of $M$
regarded as an $A_{\overline X}|_U$-module on $\overline X_{\mathrm{proet}}/U$.
Such a factorization is unique because $j$ is an open immersion. Restriction
is the restriction in $M$ whenever the source factors through $U$, and is the
zero map otherwise; $A_{\overline X}(V)=(A_{\overline X}|_U)(V\to U)\cong A_U(V\to U)$
acts on $M(V\to U)$ through the $A_U$-module structure of $M$. A morphism
$\alpha:M\to M'$ acts on $P_M$ by $\alpha_{V\to U}$ on the nonzero values, and
$j_!\alpha$ is its sheafification. This defines the functor

$$
 j_!: \Sh(U_{\mathrm{proet}},A)
 \longrightarrow \Sh(\overline X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)
$$

by its action on sections and sheafification; no conservativity of ordinary
geometric stalks is part of the definition.

split_report.summary: Checked the definition against Stacks 03DI (sites-modules-lemma-extension-by-zero: j_! is the sheafification of V ↦ ⊕_{φ∈Mor(V,U)} G(V→U)) and 09AE (proetale-definition-extension-zero); the blueprint's presheaf is the special case where Mor(V,U) has at most one element, which holds as j is a monomorphism. The statement is kept; it now names the identification of U_proet with the localization X_proet/U and of A_U with A_X|_U (new lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization, unsplit), which the formula M(V→U) and the A_X(V)-module structure on it silently used, adds the module structure and the action on morphisms, and points to the new definition of the extension-by-zero presheaf (def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf, Stacks 03DI, unsplit) and to sheafification of presheaves of modules over a sheaf of rings (def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification, Mathlib leaf PresheafOfModules.sheafification). The open immersion is now def-weil-open-immersion instead of the umbrella def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties; def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf and def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category are named. The adjunction j_! ⊣ j^{-1} is not part of this definition: it is the statement lem-weil-extension-by-zero-adjunction, which depends on this node. Mathlib has the generalization SheafOfModules.pullback along Over.forget U (left adjoint of SheafOfModules.overFunctor) on the localized site, not a one-line specialization. The pointer to def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility is left as cut by the lead.
